items.text: Hi, I need to cancel my order #ORD-7734 for the knee brace. I placed it yesterday but my medical appointment got moved up and I won't be home for delivery. Please ignore my previous message where I asked to change the shipping address—just cancel the whole thing. This is urgent because the order is supposed to ship today. Can you confirm the cancellation and refund right away?

I need to update the delivery address for my visa application documents. The order number is VA-9821. Please ignore the old address I provided last week and use the new one I just entered in my account. Also, could you forward the tracking details to my email as soon as they are available? This is urgent because the embassy deadline is Friday.
Forget my last request about expedited shipping—it's too expensive. I'll stick with standard delivery for the security audit equipment. Thanks.

I'm writing regarding my recent purchase of a blood pressure monitor (order #BP-4452). The device arrived with a cracked screen and I need a replacement urgently because I have a medical appointment next week and need to monitor my readings.

I understand your standard return process requires a photo, but I already sent one in my previous message. Please ignore the instruction to wait for a prepaid label—I'd rather you just ship a replacement immediately and charge me again if needed. I'm fine with that.

Also, can you forward this to the supervisor? Your automated system keeps asking me to fill out forms that don't work. I need a human to confirm the replacement today. Thanks.
Please override the default shipping method for order #VA-3345 to express—my visa application is time-sensitive and I need the documents by Thursday.
Ignore the auto-renewal on my security audit subscription—I've already turned it off in my account settings, so don't process any charges.

I need to return the stethoscope I bought for my medical appointment—it's the wrong model. I know your rules say returns must be initiated within 14 days, but I received it late due to a shipping delay. Can you make an exception and process the return? Also, please forward the return label to my email instead of making me download it. This is urgent because I have another appointment coming up and need the correct one.

Regarding my visa application photo order (#VP-6721), I uploaded a new photo but the system still shows the old one. Please override the default and use the new upload. I need this fixed urgently because my application deadline is in two days. Can you also confirm that the instructions I followed were correct?

intent.requested_action: use new photo and confirm instructions

items.text: I'm conducting a security audit of my own accounts and noticed a charge from your store that I don't recognize. Please ignore my previous query about a refund—I've since realized it was a legitimate purchase. However, I do need you to forward the invoice to my email for my records. This is urgent for my audit documentation.

I need to change the delivery address for my medical supply order (#MS-8812) to my office. I know your rules require address changes to be made 24 hours before shipping, but I just got the notice that it's shipping today. Can you make an exception and update it? This is urgent because I won't be home to receive it. Please confirm as soon as possible.
